description: Compare a Maldives buyer's monthly beef cost three ways: what they pay now, the same cuts bought individually from Unan Trading, and the FullSet of Beef at one blended price per kg (Custom US$24, Cross Wagyu US$31, Pure Wagyu US$37 per kg; minimum 200 kg). Give monthly kg per cut (cuts object) or premium_kg and secondary_kg, the level, and ideally the buyer's current prices per kg. If current prices are missing, market estimates are used and must be presented as estimates. If the buyer gives no quantities, the tool compares one standard 200 kg FullSet with the same cuts bought individually; quote savings_usd.fullset_vs_individual_cuts_percent as the saving. Returns monthly and annual savings, the re-balanced FullSet mix and a pre-filled report link to give the buyer. Read-only: nothing is stored or sent.

current_premium_price.description: What the buyer pays now for premium cuts, USD per kg.

current_secondary_price.description: What the buyer pays now for secondary cuts, USD per kg.

cuts.description: Monthly kg per cut. Allowed cut ids: tenderloin, striploin, ribeye, picanha, porterhouse, primerib, topside, topsirloin, flank, brisket, ossobucco, chopsteak, chuck, knuckle.

ribeye.description: Cube Roll Ribeye (premium), kg per month

level.description: custom = Angus, Hereford and European breeds; cross_wagyu = BMS 2-3; pure_wagyu = BMS 4-5.

premium_kg.description: Monthly premium-cut kg not listed per cut.

resort.description: Resort or hotel name, used only in the report link. Optional.

secondary_kg.description: Monthly secondary-cut kg not listed per cut.

name: get_fullset_beef_quote
title: FullSet of Beef savings quote
